summary_en: The video provides a detailed guide on cooking flavorful Thai hotpot with flowers, presented by two hosts in a modern kitchen setting. The chef prepares ingredients by shaping minced fish into balls, stir-frying straw mushrooms, boiling and peeling prawns, and then simmering the broth with a pre-made seasoning packet before adding all ingredients to complete the dish.
